source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 4, 5. Ἐτιθηνοῦντο τὸ πρὶν ἐπὶ κόκκου, τὸ μέλλον ἐκχεῖσθαι τοῦ σωτῆρος αἶμα προφητικῶς προακούοντες, καὶ νῦν ἐκ τῶν γηίνων νοημάτων ῥακοδυτοῦντες.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] Formerly they were being nursed upon scarlet, having heard prophetically beforehand the Savior’s blood about to be poured out, and now being rag-clad from the earthy thoughts.
pass_b_english: Formerly they were being nursed upon scarlet, having heard prophetically beforehand the Savior’s blood about to be poured out, and now being rag-clad from the earthy thoughts (Lamentations 4:5).

choices.why: Origen allegorizes God’s word as sword at Lam 4:9.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations disclosed in translator_notes.
